backend_differences: GRAPTOR_PARALLEL selects BACKEND_cilk instead of BACKEND_openmp
Cilk runtime/API headers and library replace -fopenmp/libgomp
CILK_NWORKERS=6; same six-core affinity mask; OpenMP binds the same cores
protocol.note: Same GCC13 application compiler; upstream Cilk API backend. Without a Cilk-language frontend the upstream parallel_for macro is its serial fallback, while parallel_loop/map_partitionL use the real Cilk runtime. No source adaptations hide this distinction.
protocol.timer: Same whole-process CLOCK_MONOTONIC wrapper; same gettimeofday monotonic shim for recorded Graptor compute
protocol.precision: Saved double PageRank; saved float32 SSSP weights; same application sources and settings
